analysis: Examined base lines 620-1556 of ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift. Changes per range map: (1) head 577 and head 1023 add GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice.report(error, modelID:) after load failure and at stream-start failure (base ~1019-1021). Its implementation is not supplied; integration must confirm it logs or reports only a typed wired-limit classification and never String(describing: error) or prompt-derived text. The adjacent comment at base 1022-1029 notes that rich error text can carry prompt content (A-001, T-050-class log exposure). This is unverified, not a finding. (2) Base 1146 and base 1216 rename firstWithheldReasoningAt to firstWithheldOutputAt. This widens the pre-content deadline bypass and the TTFT anchor to withheld answer text, not only reasoning. Withheld output stops the pre-content deadline check at base 1146-1150, so a request can continue past firstContentDeadline when it has generated but unframed output. This affects availability and capacity semantics, not confidentiality. TTFT sampling feeds routing quotes only (T-041/SEC-035 timing is unchanged in kind). Integration should verify where EngineV2RequestUsageSignal sets firstWithheldOutputAt and that withheld answer text is eventually framed or hashed consistently. The response hash at base 1512-1516 covers only fullResponseText of emitted frames; if withheld answer text is later emitted outside this loop, hash and billing coverage need checking (T-007, billing). Encryption fail-closed paths (T-008) at base 797-857 are unchanged. No concrete regression was identified in the visible source.
